title: Fixed-income wash-trading review
guidance: Compare economic exposure, clean price, accrued interest and settlement terms. Test common control, matched quantities, repeated opposite direction and whether illiquidity or dealer facilitation explains the pattern.

title: FX wash-trading review
guidance: Compare currency pair, value date, notional, direction and execution window. Test internalisation, roll activity, benchmark windows, shared control and whether net currency exposure genuinely changed.

title: Interest-rate derivatives wash-trading review
guidance: Compare DV01 and curve exposure rather than notional alone. Check lifecycle events, compression, novation, package hedges, clearing identifiers and whether apparently opposite trades leave material rate risk.

title: Credit-derivatives wash-trading review
guidance: Compare spread risk, reference entity, seniority, maturity and index or single-name legs. Test allocations, compression, common control and whether the combined position materially changed default exposure.

title: Spoofing and layering review
guidance: Check order-book level, cancellation timing, opposite-side fills, price impact, recurrence and peer behaviour. Separate genuine liquidity provision and volatile-market repricing from potentially manipulative layering.

title: Potential front-running review
guidance: Verify information access, client-order timing, instrument linkage, price advantage and recurrence. Consider pre-existing positions, hedging mandates and public market events as counter-evidence.

title: General evidence sufficiency
guidance: Prioritisation is not a misconduct finding. Identify missing market context, entity confidence, data lineage and economic-exposure evidence before recommending the next investigative step.
